*Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 23.20) is a canonical Theravāda Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection [SuttaCentral]. In accordance with its title, the text examines the conditional relations (*paccaya*) operating at the intersection of the triad of feeling (*vedanāttika*) and the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*) within the combinatorial framework of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral].
Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus records any parallels in Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit Buddhist corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali canon, however, DharmaNexus identifies widespread formulaic text reuse, recording 341 matching passages shared with 46 other Abhidhamma texts [DharmaNexus]. The most substantial reuse occurs with closely related structural divisions of the *Paṭṭhāna*, notably *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 1.3), *Kusalattika, Tika* (Patthana 5.1), *Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 23.1, Patthana 11.1, and Patthana 17.1), *Tika Kusalattika* (Patthana 5.2), *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 13.2), and parallel combinatorial treatments bearing the same title, such as *Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* in Patthana 11.10 and Patthana 17.21 [DharmaNexus].
